body.purpose: List items, sidebar text, UI labels. The workhorse size at 14px.

components.name: Recording Button

components.css: .ds-btn-record { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #C8933B; color: #0f0f0f; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-btn-record:hover { background: #d9a44b; transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-btn-record:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #C8933B 68%, white); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-record.is-recording { background: #8a6528; animation: ds-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.6; } }

narrative.overview:
谨迹 is a macOS journal app built on the metaphor of an archival ledger — the kind kept in brass-clasped bindings on ink-friendly paper, where every entry is deliberate and nothing calls attention to itself. The interface recedes so the content can breathe.

The signature move is the ink-cyan neutral system: all grays carry a subtle cold-cyan tint, sitting in a precise middle register that feels like high-quality paper under cool studio lighting. There is one and only one accent color: amber-gold — the color of aged brass, archival ink, and quality leather. Everything else is neutral.

Typography is SF Pro via system-ui — the system font that disappears into the OS. The layout alternates between dense (list panel, 14px) and spacious (detail panel, 16px, 1.75 line-height). This contrast is intentional: scanning is fast, reading is comfortable.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-cyan neutral surfaces — every gray has a subtle cold-cyan tint, never dead gray
One and only one accent: amber-gold for all interactive states
System font stack — SF Pro on macOS, zero loading cost
Dark mode as primary quality benchmark; light mode equally polished
4px spacing base unit with tight-loose rhythm
Animation discipline: transform + opacity only, ≤300ms, ease-out-quart
Three-column layout: resizable left list + center detail + toggleable right panel

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber-gold is the one and only accent color. Never introduce a second chromatic color into the accent vocabulary. Amber-gold covers every interactive emphasis, without exception.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: #000000 and #ffffff are forbidden. Every neutral surface and text color carries the ink-cyan tint.

rules.name: The Ink-Cyan Neutral Rule
rules.body: All grays carry a subtle cold-cyan undertone (OKLCH hue 195–250). Warm-toned grays and dead grays are prohibited.

rules.name: The No-Extremes Rule
rules.body: Font weights 300 and 700+ are intentionally excluded. Hierarchy is built through size differences and the 400→500→600 ladder.

rules.name: The One-Font Rule
rules.body: All UI text uses the system font stack. IBM Plex Mono is reserved for code semantics.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Never add box-shadow to cards, list items, panels, or containers as decoration.

rules.name: The Left-Bar Rule
rules.body: The primary depth signal for selected or highlighted list items is a 2px left border in amber-gold.

dos: Do use amber-gold for all interactive accent moments — buttons, selections, active states, links, checkboxes.
Do keep all neutrals ink-cyan tinted — every gray should have a subtle cold-cyan undertone.
Do use the left-bar pattern (2px amber border-left) for selected and highlighted list items.
Do maintain the density contrast: tight list (14px) vs. spacious detail (16px, 1.75lh).
Do animate only transform and opacity.
Do use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all transitions.
donts: Don't introduce a second chromatic accent — amber-gold is the one and only accent color.
Don't use pure #000000 or #ffffff — use ink-tinted near-black and near-white.
Don't use warm-toned grays — the neutral system is ink-cyan.
Don't add card shadows or card-in-card nesting.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing — ease-out-quart only.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, margin, padding).
Don't use decorative blur, gradients, or glow effects.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with gradient).
Don't use font weights below 400 or above 600.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored side-stripe — the 2px left-bar is the sole exception.
Don't use IBM Plex Mono outside of code blocks.
Don't use identical card grids with icon + heading + text repeated endlessly.
Don't use modals as the first solution.
Don't add color to Markdown headings in light mode.
